# The same array type with a cap of 64 bytes, count 16 (16 x 4 = 64, within the cap), and 8 bytes after it.

type ints
breaks 5.4, point 4.4
expect Truncated -
offset 0
extent 12
requests none
input 00000010 00000000 00000000
